verdict.rationale: Proa is a Rust web framework used through code and a CLI (proa new, proa ui add, proa site routes). It has no end-user dashboard or UI whose actions an API would need to mirror, so API-vs-UI parity is a category error for this kind of product. The openapi.json probe only shows the site serves a spec somewhere; nothing ties it to a product UI or claims parity, so it does not make the axis applicable.
